content: Yinni Gusunɔ u Sɑmuɛli sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, sere sɑɑ yerɑ̀ kɑɑ n wɑ̃ɑ ɑ n Sɔɔlu swĩiyɑmmɛ. Domi nɑ nùn bɑndu yɑrɑ. U ǹ mɑɑ kpɛ̃ u bɑndu di Isirelibɑ sɔɔ. Yen sɔ̃, ɑ ɡum yibio wunɛn kɔbɑ ye sɔɔ kpɑ n nun ɡɔri ɑ dɑ Isɑi, Bɛtelehɛmuɡiin mi. Domi nɑ win bii turo ɡɔsɑ u kɑ ko sunɔ wi nɑ kĩ.
Adɑmɑ Sɑmuɛli nɛɛ, ɑmɔnɑ kon ko n kɑ dɑ mi, domi Sɔɔlu ù n ye nuɑ, u koo mɑn ɡo. Mɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u nɛɛ, ɑ nɑɑ ɡbiibɑ suo kpɑ ɑ nɛɛ, ɑ nɑwɑ ɑ kɑ mɑn yɑ̃kuru kuɑ.
Kpɑ ɑ Isɑi soku yɑ̃ku yeru mi. Miyɑ kon nun sɔ̃ ye kɑɑ ko. Yerɑ ɑ ɡum tɑ̃re wi kon nun sɔ̃ɔsin wirɔ.
Sɑmuɛli u kuɑ nɡe mɛ Yinni Gusunɔ u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ. Ye u nɑ Bɛtelehɛmuɔ, yerɑ wuu ɡen ɡuro ɡurobu bɑ nɑ win mi kɑ bɛrum bɑ nɛɛ, n kɑ sere do mɛ?

Mɑ Sɑmuɛli u bu wisɑ u nɛɛ, n do ɡbɑ̃ɑ ɡbɑ̃ɑ. Nɑ nɑwɑ n kɑ Yinni Gusunɔ yɑ̃kuru kuɑ. I bɛɛn tii disi wunɑrio kpɑ i nɑ yɑ̃ku yerɔ. Mɑ Sɑmuɛli u mɑɑ Isɑi kɑ win bii tɔn durɔbu sokɑ. Bɑ tii disi wunɑri bɑ nɑ yɑ̃ku yeru mi.
Sɑɑ ye be kpuro bɑ tunumɑ, yerɑ Sɑmuɛli u Eliɑbu wɑ. Mɑ u bwisikɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ̀ n dɑ wiyɑ mi, wi Yinni Gusunɔ u ɡɔsɑ.
Adɑmɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u Sɑmuɛli sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ ku win wɑsin burɑm mɛɛri, ǹ kun mɛ win ɡunum, n ǹ wi, nɑ ɡɔsɑ. Domi nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ, nɑ ku rɑ wɑsin burɑm mɛɛri nɡe tɔnu. Gɔ̃ruwɑ nɑ rɑ mɛɛri.
Mɑ Isɑi u Abinɑdɑbu sokɑ, u derɑ u susi Sɑmuɛlin wuswɑɑɔ. Mɑ Sɑmuɛli u nɛɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ kun mɑɑ wini ɡɔsɑ.
Mɑ Isɑi u derɑ Sɑmɑ u susi Sɑmuɛlin wuswɑɑɔ. Adɑmɑ Sɑmuɛli u nɛɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ kun winin tii ɡɔsɑ.
Isɑi u derɑ win bibu nɔɔbɑ yiru bɑ susi Sɑmuɛlin wuswɑɑɔ. Adɑmɑ Sɑmuɛli u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, Yinni kun ben ɡoo ɡɔsɑ.

Mɑ u Isɑi bikiɑ u nɛɛ, wunɛn bii tɔn durɔbu kpurowɑ mini? Isɑi u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, ben dɑ̃ɑko wi bɑ mɔ̀ Dɑfidi, wiyɑ u woo, u yɑ̃ɑnu kpɑrɑmɔ. Yerɑ Sɑmuɛli u nɛɛ, ɑ de bu nùn kɑsumɑ. Domi sɑ ǹ kpɛ̃ su yɑ̃kuru ko mɑ n kun mɔ u nɑ.
Mɑ Isɑi u derɑ bɑ nùn kɑso dɑ bɑ kɑ nɑ. Dɑfidi wi, u sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔn swɑ̃ɔ, u wɑsi bwɑ̃ɑ do, u mɑɑ wɑɑbu wɑ̃. Mɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u nɛɛ, ɑ seewo ɑ nùn ɡum mɛ tɑ̃re domi wiyɑ nɑ ɡɔsɑ.
Yerɑ Sɑmuɛli u win kɔbɑ ye suɑ u nùn ɡum mɛ tɑ̃re win mɑɑbun wuswɑɑɔ. Mɑ Gusunɔn Hunde u Dɑfidi yɔɔwɑ sɑɑ dɔmɑ ten di. Yen biru Sɑmuɛli u ɡɔsirɑ u wurɑ Rɑmɑɔ.
Yen biru Gusunɔn Hunde u Sɔɔlu deri mɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u derɑ hunde kɔ̃sɑ yɑ nùn tɔ̃yɑ mɔ̀.
Mɑ Sɔɔlun bwɑ̃ɑbu bɑ nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ nɛɛ, wee Yinni Gusunɔ u derɑ hunde kɔ̃sɑ yɑ nun tɔ̃yɑ mɔ̀.
Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, bɛsɛn yinni, ɑ de su ɡoo kɑsu wi u mɔrɔku soberu yɛ̃. Yinni Gusunɔ ù n derɑ hunde kɔ̃sɑ yɑ nun seeri, kpɑ u mɔrɔku ɡe so kpɑ yu sɑrɑ.
Mɑ Sɔɔlu u win bwɑ̃ɑ be wisɑ u nɛɛ, i doo i ɡoo kɑsu wi u mɔrɔku soberu yɛ̃ sɑ̃ɑ sɑ̃ɑ kpɑ i kɑ nùn nɑ nɛn mi.

Mɑ win bɔ̃ɔ turo u nɛɛ, nɑ Isɑi Bɛtelehɛmuɡiin bii turo wɑɑre wi u mɔrɔku soberu yɛ̃. U mɑɑ wɔruɡɔru mɔ ɡem ɡem, u sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɑbu durɔ, u rɑ mɑɑ ɡɑri ɡere kɑ lɑɑkɑri. Durɔ burɔn tiiwɑ. Yinni Gusunɔ mɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ kɑ wi.
Yerɑ Sɔɔlu u ɡɔrɑ Isɑin mi, u nɛɛ, ɑ mɑn wunɛn bii Dɑfidi yɑ̃ɑ kpɑro wi kɛ̃ɛmɑ u nɑ nɛn mi.
Mɑ Isɑi u pɛ̃ɛ suɑ kɑ tɑm mɛ bɑ doke yɑɑ ɡɔnɑn bɔɔru sɔɔ, kɑ boo kpɛmu, u ye kpuro kɛtɛku sɔbi. Mɑ u Dɑfidi swɑɑ sure kɑ yɑ̃ɑ ni kpuro u dɑ Sɔɔlun mi.
Ye u turɑ mi, u kuɑ win bɔ̃ɔ. Sɔɔlu u nùn kĩɑ ɡem ɡem mɑ u nùn kuɑ win tɑbu yɑ̃ɑ sɔwo.
Mɑ Sɔɔlu u mɑɑ ɡɔrɑ Isɑin mi, u nɛɛ, ɑ mɑn Dɑfidi derio u n sɑ̃ɑ nɛn sɔm kowo, domi win dɑɑ yɑ mɑn dore.
Sɑɑ dɔmɑ ten di, Yinni Gusunɔ ù n derɑ hunde kɔ̃sɑ yɑ Sɔɔlu seeri, Dɑfidi u rɑ win mɔrɔku suewɑ u so, kpɑ hunde kɔ̃sɑ ye, yu sɑrɑ. Kpɑ win lɑɑkɑri yu wurɑmɑ mɑm mɑm.
Dɑfidi kɑ Goliɑti
